doc.title: Don Wolff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996

title: Closing thanks
summary: Both thank each other and head off to hear the Basie band.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I can’t think of a better way to wrap this conversation up.

Well I can think of one better way, and that is to thank you for what you’re doing. Because I think to do this for the students that are going to benefit from this in the years ahead, is wonderful, and I think you all are setting a good example for other institutions and I appreciate what you’re doing. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
All right. Well on behalf of Hamilton College, I want to thank Don Wolff for his time and we’re off to enjoy some music with the Basie Band and Joe Williams.
